name: MKV-Orchestrator
description: MKV Orchestrator is a media operations console for scanning MKV/MP4 files, reviewing media and track metadata, renaming files from TVDB/TMDB metadata, mux/remux planning, track property edits, and library overview workflows. The container includes MKVToolNix and FFmpeg/FFprobe. Mount your Unraid shares into /media and optionally /downloads; configure provider API keys in the web Settings page or through the optional masked environment variables below.

paths.name: Media Path
paths.description: Primary media library path mounted into the container.

paths.name: Downloads Path
paths.description: Optional downloads or staging path mounted into the container.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Persistent MKV Orchestrator settings, logs, and cache data.

variables.name: Authentication Mode
variables.description: Accepted inputs: auto, basic, or disabled. Use disabled only on a trusted LAN. Use basic with both Web UI credentials below. Use auto to require credentials whenever the server accepts remote connections.

variables.name: Media Root
variables.description: Default root used by the Dashboard browser.

variables.name: Source Roots
variables.description: Additional named source roots. /media is added automatically; use name=/container/path entries separated by commas.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns files created by MKVO. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns files created by MKVO. Unraid default: 100 (users).

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File creation mask for new files.

variables.name: Web UI Username
variables.description: Required with Web UI Password when Authentication Mode is basic. Leave blank when authentication is disabled.

variables.name: Web UI Password
variables.description: Required with Web UI Username when Authentication Mode is basic. Leave blank when authentication is disabled.

variables.name: Edit Workers
variables.description: Maximum concurrent mkvpropedit track property edits.

variables.name: TVDB API Key
variables.description: Optional container-managed TVDB API key. It appears as configured in MKVO Settings after the container restarts, but its value remains masked.

variables.name: TVDB PIN
variables.description: Optional container-managed TVDB subscriber PIN. It appears as configured in MKVO Settings after the container restarts, but its value remains masked.

variables.name: TMDB API Key
variables.description: Optional container-managed TMDB API key. It appears as configured in MKVO Settings after the container restarts, but its value remains masked.
